Fungua akaunti bure

Fungua akaunti bure

Jiandikishe mara moja na uwe tayari mtumiaji katika Rent na Market. Hakuna ada ya kujiunga.

Used for viewing confirmations and, if you are a tenant, rent reminders.
At least 10 characters. A passphrase of four unrelated words is stronger than a short password with symbols.

What you get immediately

  • ✓Saved searches and favorites that sync to the app
  • ✓Chat with owners and agents on any listing
  • ✓Viewing calendar with email and SMS confirmation
  • ✓A tenant portal if you rent a TRIXX-managed home
  • ✓A user account already active in Rent and Market

Already registered?

If you have ever used a TRIXX app, your account already exists. Use the same email to sign in here.
